title: The Voluptuous Apocalypse
listing_description: A political and psychological study of the hidden appeal of collapse, the fatigue of reform, and the difficult work of changing systems without romanticizing ruins.
reader_hook: Investigate the relief that fantasies of ending can offer, then ask how criticism, exit, repair, and simplification can become more than a wish for the meteor.

source_excerpt.start_heading: CHAPTER 1 — SECRETLY, WE WANT THE METEOR
source_excerpt.end_heading: CHAPTER 2 — THE SYSTEM THAT CANNOT FORGET
